title: V11 Task Metadata
description: Schema for task metadata including artifact handoffs

type.description: Task classification: standard (actionable work), discovery (informational), finding (audit result)

severity.description: Severity tier for finding tasks. Required when type=finding.

agent.description: Recommended agent for this task (push-recommend). Populated by agent-assignment subagent during Phase 3. Under V11.11+ this field is expected on every task; sync-tasks emits an advisory when missing. The claimant (TaskUpdate owner=...) may override the recommendation — this is the pull-confirm half of push-recommend/pull-confirm.

spec_test_requirements.description: Executable assertions derived from spec.md that the implementer must satisfy. Addresses Dark Code Layer 1 (Specs as Evals) — specs are not just review-time evals, they are coding-time checklists. Populated by the Phase 3 interview, consumed by implementers on task claim.

no_str.description: Explicit override flag (V11.8, S1-7): when true, acknowledges that spec_test_requirements are inapplicable or postponed for this task. sync-tasks advisory suppressed when set. Use sparingly — the intent of Dark Code Layer 1 is that complex/novel tasks carry executable assertions.

review_of.description: V11.21: On a paired review task, the parent work task ID this review covers. Acts as the load-bearing structural signal that this is a review sibling (belt-and-suspenders with metadata.agent matching adversarial-* pattern). Attribution traversal: review_task → review_of → parent → recommended_agents[parent_id]. Absent on normal work tasks.

review_id.description: V11.21: Optional pointer to a specific review verdict within metadata.artifacts.review (used when multiple reviews exist on one task, or as a stable ID for cross-reference). Not required for the standard one-review-per-task case.

review_task_id.description: V11.21: On a PARENT work task, the forward link to its paired adversarial-lite review task ID. Set by the orchestrator skill at Phase 4 pair time. Enables O(1) V11.19 enqueue suppression in sync-tasks (no TaskList scan needed) and INV-3 grouping in scripts/status. Mutual exclusion: when present, sync-tasks does NOT enqueue to the V11.19 deferred queue (per-task coupling, not per-project).

parent_status.description: V11.21: Status state machine for paired review tasks. pending_parent = parent work task not yet completed (orchestrator Phase 4 dispatch filter skips these; sync-tasks transitions to pending on parent completion via idempotent V11.16 ledger event). After parent completes, the review task follows the normal pending → in_progress → completed lifecycle. Absent on non-review tasks.

skip_review.description: V11.21: Explicit opt-out from Phase 4 auto-pair. Used for framework-machinery tasks (orchestrator meta-tasks, the paired review tasks themselves, user-flagged exempt work). The orchestrator skill honors this at TaskCreate time and does not pair a sibling. INV-7 recursion termination also checks this; together with metadata.review_of presence and exempt_agent_patterns, this is one of three independent guards against runaway review chains.

synthetic_completion.description: V11.21: Marker that this completion event was generated by sync-tasks (e.g., INV-11 NONE auto-completion for cancelled/abandoned paired reviews). sync-tasks skips these from agent-errors.jsonl and attribution-keys.jsonl writes to prevent ledger pollution from framework-machinery state transitions. Absent on user-driven completions.

trace_id.description: Unique ID carried across all task hops for observability

handoff_note.description: Explicit instructions for the next agent

api_contract.description: API endpoints, their signatures, and behavioral contracts. Each value may be a legacy signature string OR a structured object with preconditions, postconditions, invariants, idempotency, and SLA. Structured form addresses Dark Code Layer 3 (Semantic Context) gaps — interfaces define 'rules of engagement', not just shape.

test_hints.description: Specific test scenarios for the tester agent

artifact_refs.description: References to large artifacts stored externally

review.description: Adversarial-lite-reviewer verdict for this task (V11.15). Written by the orchestrator post-task review step; consumed by sync-tasks for per-agent metric attribution. Optional — absence = no review ran (backward compatible).

self_review.description: V11.21 Layer A: implementing agent's self-review verdict emitted in its own TaskUpdate(completed) payload. Cheap (~500 tokens in-context), forces articulation, attributes directly to the executor. Honesty is enforced by INV-3 calibration miss counter (scripts/agent-scorecard self_review_miss column: when self=NONE/LOW but adversarial=HIGH/CRITICAL on the same parent, the miss counter increments — without this counter Layer A would be ceremony). Pairs with metadata.artifacts.review (Layer B, written on the SIBLING review task, not here).

meta_feedback.description: Self-critique by the task agent (V11.15). The agent rates its own system prompt and explains why errors occurred. Persisted by sync-tasks for the Quality Flywheel. Advisory only — does NOT feed DAAO routing in this phase.

path.description: Relative path to artifact file in sessions/{project}/artifacts/{task_id}/

spec_test_requirement.description: One executable assertion traced back to a specific spec clause

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. STR-001. Referenced from code comments and test names.

spec_section.description: Relative path or section anchor in spec.md where this requirement originates

assertion.description: What the code must demonstrate. Should be checkable by reading the code or running a test. Example: 'Refresh tokens rotate on every /auth/refresh call — old token is invalidated before new one is issued.'

test_pointer.description: Optional path to the test file/function that exercises this assertion once implementation is complete

status.description: Lifecycle status — updated by implementer and tester

oneOf.description: Legacy signature string — e.g., '{ email, password } -> { token }'. Accepted for backward compatibility. New code should use the structured form.
Structured behavioral contract (Dark Code Layer 3 compliance)

signature.description: Human-readable signature (e.g., 'POST /auth/login { email, password } -> { token, refresh }')

method.description: HTTP method for endpoints, or FUNCTION/EVENT/COMPONENT for non-HTTP interfaces

path.description: URL path, function name, or event topic

request_schema.description: JSON Schema or description of expected input

response_schema.description: JSON Schema or description of expected output

preconditions.description: Required state or input validity before calling. Example: 'Caller must hold valid session token'

postconditions.description: Guaranteed state after successful call. Example: 'New row inserted into sessions table'

invariants.description: Conditions that must remain true before AND after call

idempotent.description: Safe to call multiple times with same arguments?

retryable.description: Safe to retry on failure (network error, timeout)?

failure_modes.description: Expected error cases and how clients should respond

side_effects.description: Observable effects beyond return value (DB writes, emails sent, external API calls)

review.description: Adversarial-lite-reviewer output. Scoped to the task's files_changed only — never a whole-repo review.

agent_id.description: Agent that executed the reviewed task — the subject of metric attribution

difficulty.description: Reviewer's rating of how hard the task was (1=trivial, 5=very hard). Feeds avg_difficulty per agent.

errors.description: Individual errors found in the task output

verdict.description: PASS=0 CRIT/HIGH & <=3 MED; ISSUES_FOUND=any HIGH or >3 MED; BLOCKED=any CRITICAL

auto_fix.description: Outcome of the severity-routed fix step, if any

escalated.description: CRITICAL error ids escalated to orchestrator (blocker task created, no auto-edit)

id.description: Stable error id within this review, e.g. 'E1'

type.description: Error class, e.g. compilation, test_failure, contract_violation, security, logic, completeness, integration, unmeasured_causal_claim (Lens 4, V11.21.1)

detail.description: What is wrong and why it matters

fix_hint.description: How to fix it (consumed by lite-fixer)

self_review.description: V11.21 Layer A self-review verdict. Emitted by the implementing agent in its own TaskUpdate(completed) payload. Cheap in-context articulation. Falsifiability is provided by the calibration miss counter (INV-3) — without that signal, this layer is ceremony.

severity.description: Overall self-assessed severity of remaining concerns. NONE = clean work, no concerns. The calibration miss counter triggers when self ∈ {NONE,LOW} but the paired adversarial review verdict has severity ∈ {HIGH,CRITICAL}.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of confidence and what was/wasn't verified. The whole point of forcing articulation.

errors.description: Self-identified concerns. Uses the same review_error shape as adversarial verdicts so calibration miss detection can compare apples-to-apples.

agent_id.description: Self-reviewing agent ID (== executing agent ID). Set by sync-tasks from task-state active_agent_id; emit by agent for cross-check.

meta_feedback.description: Task agent's structured self-critique. Aggregated by scripts/flywheel-ingest into agent-prompt-improvement proposals. Advisory only.

system_prompt_rating.description: How well the agent's own system prompt equipped it for this task (1=poorly, 5=excellently)

error_postmortem.description: If the agent produced errors, why — root cause from the agent's own perspective

v11_suggestions.description: Concrete V11 framework or system-prompt tweaks that would have prevented the errors

prompt_friction.description: Parts of the system prompt or task that were ambiguous, contradictory, or missing

finding_metadata.description: Structured audit finding with location, problem, fix, and classification

context.description: Surrounding code snippet or function name

problem.description: Clear description of what is wrong

found_by.description: Agent IDs that independently found this issue (populated during synthesis)

dedup_of.description: Task ID of the canonical finding this duplicates (set during synthesis)
